profile.name: Kaili Stacey
profile.title: Private Maths & Science Tutor
profile.tagline: Helping you achieve your academic goals, one step at a time
profile.heading: Hi, I'm Kaili.
profile.summary: I hold a PHD in nanochemistry and have over 8 years of experience teaching and tutoring students in various levels of Maths and Science.
bio: I love helping students discover what they're capable of. Helping my students learn to trust their ability, grow their understanding, and develop their skills brings me real joy. In fact, that's what inspired me to become a tutor in the first place. I want to help students feel confident in their abilities and excited about learning.

I specialise in teaching Primary and Secondary level Maths, Chemistry and Physics and University level Maths and Chemistry. I've loved stem subjects since I was a child, and I want to share that love with my students. I believe that anyone can learn and excel in these subjects with the right guidance and support.

Outside of teaching, I’m a lifelong reader and always have a book with me. I also love to sew and do so regularly. I love the process of turning a flat piece of fabric into a finished garment — it's a satisfying blend of structure and imagination.
experience: Full-time tutor for over 2 years with over 2000 tutoring hours.
Five years of experience as a chemistry laboratory demonstrator at Flinders University, teaching practical and theoretical chemistry to hundreds of students across all levels.
Experience with SACE, HSC, QCAA, WACE, and VCE year 11/12 curriculums.
Familiarity with AUS8-10 maths and science curriculums.
